# Draft:War//Plague

[https://www.warplague.com/ WAR//PLAGUE] is a Minneapolis based hardcore punk/crust punk band that formed in the Spring of 2008 and have been active ever since.
"Exposing the world of its horrors through rage and music"
Forming in early 2008, War//Plague have been one of the most dedicated and productive crust punk bands for the last decade bringing socio/political rage and ferocity to their music.
WAR//PLAGUE will be crossing their 17 year anniversary threshold in 2026 and have an expansive catalog that includes split releases with some legendary bands such as WARWOUND, AXEGRINDER and more.
